    Editing needs the agentbox-setup server. It parses agentbox.toml and changes only the values you edit, so your comments and layout are kept. This page cannot do that by itself.

    Start it from the repository root:

    ./scripts/start-agentbox.sh

    If there is no compiled binary yet, build it once with cargo build --release in setup/.
